description: Lists the public pictures in the AIKIZI Brain (aikizi.com/brain) that are most like one of the connected account’s own decodes, published or private: up to 21, closest first, each with title, style, a small preview image, its aikizi.com/decode link and a link that opens it in the Brain. It only reads: it does not add the decode to the Brain, publish it, decode anything or spend credits, and the account’s own decode stays private. Example: {"decode_id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}.

decode_id.description: A decode id from decode_image or list_my_creations, or its aikizi.com/decode/<id> link
